requestedIntent: Owner decision 2026-11-03 (Ram, ~20:35): the Slice lane's round-2 review is generated by a tool instead of hand-written, narrow by default (the previous findings with their fix hunks, the intersections of fixes, the affected tests, mutations on the fixed lines, the slice's race tests, the contract set when touched), full scope only with one reason from a fixed list (personal-data, tenant, permissions, money, schema, fix-larger-than-slice, redesign), by the same reviewer session unless it is gone; every round-2+ report records 'Review scope: narrow | full — reason'. Security does not loosen and the one full suite before merge stays.
limitations: Wired, not enforced by ACEF: review-r2.py check fails a round-2+ report without the scope or session line, a full scope without a listed reason, or a fresh session without the 'session gone' note, but nothing in ACEF runs it before a merge. A host enforces it by adding 'review-r2.py check <report>' to its slice-method.json gate commands or its merge checklist; metrics.py only counts the scope lines.

Same reviewer session for Codex: scripts/slice/codex-review.sh starts a fresh 'codex exec' and records no thread id, so a Codex r2 in the same session means 'codex exec resume <id> -' by hand with the generated brief on stdin; the generator only records the session id it is given (--session).

Path rules are a floor: SCOPE_UP fires on route.py risk_paths (code files only); a risky fix outside every path rule is still narrow unless the coordinator passes --scope full with a reason. 'tenant' and 'redesign' have no path rule and are manual reasons only.
The size threshold review.r2_full_ratio defaults to 0.5 of the slice's code lines; it is a starting value, not a measured one.

The affected-tests map (routing.test_map) is empty until a host or stack fills it; every code file is then unmapped and the brief asks for the wider set (test_map_fallback, or the module's suite when no fallback is configured). The stacks/laravel profile ships no test_map.

Full-suite detection in check is a heuristic (a gate.sh summary line, the stack profile's bare test_command, review.full_suite_patterns) and only warns; lines inside ```diff fences (the brief's quoted hunks) are skipped.

evidence.note: 2026-11-03: narrow brief (findings with hunks, unclaimed hunks, intersections, test_map + fallback, mutations on fixed lines, race tests, contract set), full scope only with a listed reason, fresh session only with --session-gone, SCOPE_UP for a money path rule and for a fix large relative to the slice, check FAIL/WARN cases, metrics r2 scope column; one reason list across review-r2.py, metrics.py and the template.
2026-11-03: template and method strings for the r2 scope lines; metrics.py fixture row carries the r2 scope column.

2026-11-03 r1 fixes (Codex REVISE R1-R4): whole-token full reasons, written narrow/session-gone reasons, conflicting scope lines, CommonMark fences, empty expanded selectors fall back, renames classified by both paths, metrics/check parity; the 12 new checks fail on 67337a9 and pass after the fix.
